title: Remove OpenSpec and the spec and flow slots
what: plugins/openspec goes; kit.toml loses [flow] and [specs] (setup stops writing them, a migration removes them from existing projects with one line); the stage hook, relay flows, the openspec rule, kit packet if only OpenSpec uses it, docs/flows.md, doctor checks, setup flags (--specs) and their tests go; nothing else in the cycle changes. The plugin stays recoverable from git history.
why: Owner, 30 Oct, answered "a" to: drop the OpenSpec plugin, the [specs] slot and the empty [flow] slot; the queue item with its plan beside it is the only spec. Measured 30 Oct: 0 registered projects use OpenSpec (projects.toml holds only relay, no [specs] method); plugins/openspec is 14 files with 16 commits in 7 days; 52 files in lib, bin, plugins/relay|delegate|front, rules and tests mention openspec; the [flow] work slot ships no flow (kind "none" everywhere). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
